goal: Isolate the node, wallet, and GUI into separate processes communicating over IPC
Prevent memory corruption, crashes, or bugs in GUI or wallet code from compromising the node
reviewability: Stacked on #29409 whose changes are included in this diff
agreement: Strong concept support for process separation architecture (jonasschnelli, gmaxwell, Sjors, jimhashhq)
Preference for existing RPC over Cap'n Proto resolved in favor of internal IPC (dcousens, gmaxwell, laanwj)
Potential use-after-free on socket disconnect resolved with code update (practicalswift)
Concept opposition without stated technical rationale (electorr)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it provides the core IPC architecture required for process separation across Bitcoin Core
Unblocks out-of-process node and wallet execution in follow-up work

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adapts internal RPC request structures for multiprocess dispatch
Does not modify or add user-facing RPC methods

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it allows the wallet to run in an isolated address space apart from node and GUI
Protects private keys and wallet state from vulnerabilities in network-exposed node components
